discription: A warm and simple saw wave pad with a customizable ADSR envelope. Good for sustained sounds.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.01, decay=0.8, sustain=0.5, release=1.0;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Saw.ar(freq) * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
